judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is the TICKETMASTER accordion toggle: a div.qna-item__button holding an h3 and a chevron img, which opens a hidden qna-item__content panel. The snapshot's CDP tree gives it role generic, focusable true, and click and keydown listeners, with no role attribute and no aria-expanded, so the claim is true of the capture. A div scripted into a disclosure button with no role (and no expanded state) is F59, so it fails 4.1.2: a screen reader hears a heading and an image, not a button or its collapsed state. The screenshot is the styled page with the accordion collapsed, and the live page (WebFetch; curl gets an nginx 403) shows the same accordion content; nothing suggests the capture differs. The claim names that failure.

The parent toggle also fails 4.1.2 (no role or expanded state).
